{{Quote|And back again is the mighty Dud Bolt with that incredible machine - the Vulptereen 327!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fode Annodue]]|audio=Fode-DudBolt-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Vulptereen 327''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] model created by the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Some manuals referred to it as the '''RS 557'''. The Vulptereen [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]] owned a Vulptereen 327, and used it during the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic of]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During the third lap, Bolt intentionally slammed his pod into the Podracer of [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|competitor]] [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]]. Although Roose crashed, Bolt crashed his own pod as well. Bolt later returned to racing with a Vulptereen 327. Another pilot used a Vulptereen 327 during the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] race on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].
